categories.detector_fp: detection without a ground-truth box (IoU < 0.5) inside the dumped window
categories.detector_fn: ground-truth box without a detection, not explained by the rules below
categories.wrong_class: box found, class differs from the label
categories.dedup_removed: box found by the detector but removed by de-duplication
categories.containment: composite nesting (Box / LazyColumn) differs from the reference
categories.xycut_fallback: no XY-cut existed; the fallback ordering grouped the boxes
categories.tolerance_cut: cut accepted only through the tolerance; its children overlap
categories.reference_overlap: reference node hidden or stacked (covered by a later sibling, open drawer, pixels shared with other labels, FrameLayout-style overlay)
categories.reference_flat2d: reference container lays out its children in 2D without nesting (RelativeLayout style); XY-cut nests them
categories.reference_artifact: the dump does not describe the pixels (detection outside the dumped window, uniform pixels, box beyond the screen, invisible container)
categories.grouping: residual: both trees hold the boxes, XY-cut groups them differently from the view hierarchy
